crossRefs.note: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his…

But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little…
in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.
and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much…
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever…
“His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you…
In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be…
The glory which you have given me, I have given to them; that they may be one, even as we are one;
Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you…
and if children, then heirs: heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also…
having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches…
to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.
If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little…
He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father…
The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translations.bsb: To this He called you through our gospel, so that you may share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translations.kjv: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
